title: 第14章 一家子分开行动
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
人活着就是吃喝拉撒，所以这事还不好说啥。

    但等隔天一大早，魏建业醒来第一件事是要去拉屎，赵玉兰总算是忍不住了，悄咪咪地凑到婆婆跟头前问：“妈，建业是不是有什么病啊。”

    话落又忙解释，“我绝对不是不想伺候他，是真的担心！”

    饶是大小肠带点褶皱都不带这么频繁拉屎的啊。

    蔡老太正往新买的牙刷上挤绿豆大小的牙膏，这是给铁蛋和苗苗的。

    “正常，男人都这样，不是在拉屎就是拉屎的路上，起床拉，在家拉，出门前拉，路上拉，回家拉，睡觉前还要拉。”

    赵玉兰压低声音，“可是一拉能拉半个小时以上，也正常啊？”

    她不敢在魏建业面前提，就怕对方觉得自己连拉屎都要管，心里不痛快。

    蔡老太淡定点头。

    赵玉兰寻思行吧，这事就翻篇吧。

    人家是亲妈。

    那十月怀胎生下来的骨肉真有什么事，指定比她操心多了。

    她回屋卷草纸。

    几个孩子非要跟着去旱厕。

    铁蛋和苗苗边跑边喊：“努力，要努力，拉屎要用力，拉不出来没关系，至少放个屁。”

    芽芽文化水平还不到，迈着小短腿边跑边浑水摸鱼的巴拉巴拉的嘟囔。

    赵玉兰本来想喊小孩子随地大小拉就可以，到时候铲土一埋就完事。

    可她这会只追得上芽芽，这也没啥用啊，只好又回屋拿草纸，顺带邀请婆婆，“妈，你去吗？”

    蔡老太暂时没有这种世俗的愿望，但等这一大家子走后看着空空如也的水缸又不得劲。

    魏建业走的时候顺带也带走了水桶，说是等会顺带去把今儿的淡水领回来。

    所以饶是要刷牙洗脸都得等。

    刚来时听着觉得能克服，真到这时候也确实焦心。

    蔡老太揣上铝饭盒先去食堂拿早饭，边四处张望回忆。

    她也不是脑子一热就随迁。

    上辈子，七老八十的蔡老太还卖淀粉肠自力更生呢。

    余下的两儿子倒也不是不赡养。
content_en:
People only live by eating, drinking, and peeing, so it’s hard to say anything about it.

But when Wei Jianye woke up early the next morning, the first thing he did was to poop. Zhao Yulan finally couldn't help it anymore, quietly walked up to her mother-in-law and asked, "Mom, is Jianye sick?"

After he finished speaking, he quickly explained, "It's definitely not that I don't want to serve him, I'm really worried!"

No matter how wrinkled your large and small intestines are, you can poop so frequently.

Mrs. Cai was squeezing a mung bean-sized amount of toothpaste onto the newly purchased toothbrush. This was for Tiedan and Miaomiao.

"It's normal. Men are like this. Either when they poop or on the way to poop, they poop when they get up, poop at home, before going out, poop on the way, poop at home, and poop again before going to bed."

Zhao Yulan lowered her voice, "But if you can pull it for more than half an hour, is it normal?"

She didn't dare to mention it in front of Wei Jianye, because she was afraid that he would feel unhappy that she had to take care of her poop.

Mrs. Cai nodded calmly.

Zhao Yulan thinks about it, let’s just turn this story over.

She is my biological mother.

What happened to the flesh and blood born from the ten-month pregnancy was definitely more important than her to worry about.

She went back to the house to roll up toilet paper.

Several children had to follow me to the toilet.

Tiedan and Miaomiao shouted while running: "Work hard, work hard, poop hard, it doesn't matter if you can't poop out, at least fart."

Yaya's lack of education, running around on short legs and fishing in troubled waters, was the muttering of Balabala.

Zhao Yulan originally wanted to ask the children to poop anywhere, and then shovel the soil and bury them, and that would be it.

But now she could only catch up with Yaya, which was of no use, so she had to go back to the house to get some tissue paper, and invited her mother-in-law by the way, "Mom, are you going?"

Mrs. Cai has no such worldly wishes for the time being, but she feels uncomfortable looking at the empty water tank after the big family leaves.

When Wei Jianye left, he also took the bucket with him, saying that he would bring back today's fresh water later.

So even if you want to brush your teeth and wash your face, you have to wait.

When I first came here, I thought I could overcome it, but now I feel really anxious.

Mrs. Cai put on her aluminum lunch box and went to the cafeteria to get breakfast while looking around and reminiscing.

She doesn't just follow her mind.

In her previous life, Mrs. Cai, who was in her 70s and 80s, was still selling starch sausages to make a living.

It's not like we don't support the remaining two sons.
